events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church grows in Jerusalem; James leads it; believers are scattered by persecution.
James is killed about AD 62; revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Claudius (AD 41 to 54), then Nero, is emperor; Jewish communities across the empire.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written probably between the mid-40s and the early 60s AD (debated)

teaser.title: Believers are scattered
teaser.text: Persecution after Stephen's death sends believers beyond Jerusalem (Acts 8:1; 11:19).

teaser.title: James is written
teaser.text: A letter to Jewish believers in the Dispersion, probably from James of Jerusalem.

teaser.title: The Jerusalem council
teaser.text: James speaks at the council that decides how Gentiles may join the church (Acts 15).
